name: Katsuragi Shingo
source: The protagonist of the Bakumatsu period. A rogue young man running a 'jack-of-all-trades' business in the capital of Kyoto. Though his swordsmanship is self-taught, his skills are world-class. After being hired to act as Mio's bodyguard, he finds himself drawn into the heart of the incident.
